name: Enrolment Service
definition: Specifies the service details for the enrolment.

ServiceActivationLink.name: Service Activation Link
ServiceActivationLink.definition: Web page link provided by the Creditor, intended to the Debtors, to proceed to activation when  servicing messages can not be used.

ServiceActivationAllowed.name: Service Activation Allowed
ServiceActivationAllowed.definition: Define the acceptance of activation requests through the scheme.

EndDate.name: End Date
EndDate.definition: End date when the creditor enrolment becomes effective.

ServiceDescriptionLink.name: Service Description Link
ServiceDescriptionLink.definition: Information web page, as provided by the creditor, to which the debtor can be linked for further information (Universal Resource Locator - URL).

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Start date when the creditor enrolment becomes effective.

UltimateCreditor.name: Ultimate Creditor
UltimateCreditor.definition: Ultimate party to which an amount of money is due.

Visibility.name: Visibility
Visibility.definition: Provides the details of the visibility of the creditor enrolment as shown to the debtors.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party to which an amount of money is due.

OriginalEnrolment.name: Original Enrolment
OriginalEnrolment.definition: Specifies the service details for the original enrolment.

RelatedElectronicInvoiceProcessingServic.name: Related Electronic Invoice Processing Service
RelatedElectronicInvoiceProcessingServic.definition: Specifies the details service for the enrolment.

RelatedEnrolment.name: Related Enrolment
RelatedEnrolment.definition: Specifies the service details for the enrolment.
